richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Bhiwandi

c: Bhiwandi is about 20 km from our factory at Vasai East, which makes it one of the easiest towns for us to serve. FunPlay Systems supplies outdoor gym equipment in Bhiwandi to warehouse and logistics parks, powerloom units, housing complexes, schools and municipal grounds. Because we are so close, our team can visit your site, check the ground and walk the space with you before we draw the layout.

The town has grown fast around warehousing, and many new campuses have a large staff working long hours with no place to exercise. A row of outdoor machines near the canteen or parking area is a simple way to give them one. Housing complexes along the main roads are adding open gyms for residents as well. Every site here has to plan for a heavy Konkan monsoon, so drainage, a firm base and galvanised frames matter more than anything else.

facts.value: About 18 km from our Vasai factory (straight line)

facts.label: Delivery and installation
facts.value: By road from Vasai; installed by our team or a local dealer

items.q: Can your team visit our site in Bhiwandi before we order?
items.a: Yes. Bhiwandi is close to our Vasai factory, so a site visit is easy to arrange. Call +91 902 830 2266 between Monday and Saturday, 9:00 AM to 6:30 PM.

items.q: Can we install outdoor gym equipment during the monsoon?
items.a: It is possible, but grouted footings cure better in dry weather. If your site is ready, we suggest installing before June or after the rains ease.

items.q: Do you also supply housing complexes in Bhiwandi?
items.a: Yes. We supply outdoor gyms and children's play areas to residential complexes, and we can plan both on one layout with separate zones.
